integrity: The proof is analytic: nonnegative coefficients give sufficiency through induction, while a closed lower-left matrix entry gives necessity for every grid with at least two interior nodes. The one-node exception is handled exactly. The standalone checker replays finite rational consequences and the explicit witness but is not used as an exhaustive proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers the historical full-step alternation of the classical one-dimensional Saul'yev diffusion sweeps on a uniform mesh with homogeneous Dirichlet data and constant diffusion coefficient. It does not cover periodic or nonhomogeneous boundaries, variable coefficients, nonlinear problems, half-step Strang compositions, modified coefficients, group-explicit variants, or finite precision.
title: One is the sharp positivity frontier for an alternating Saul'yev diffusion pair
